data.name: Boston 250
data.headline: All Ages! • 1.5 Hours •  Celebrate America •
data.description: Join us for Tall Ships Boston, a spectacular waterfront celebration marking the 250th anniversary of the United States. Watch Boston Harbor fill with iconic ships from around the world, enjoy the energy of a city-wide celebration, and take part in a honoring America’s past, present, and future.
